render_3d_scene_with_obbs: render a 3D scene with oriented bounding boxes, camera trajectory, and frustum using draw_obb_scene_3d
render_snippet_3d_visualization: render a 3D visualization of a snippet dict with OBBs, point clouds, and camera poses using draw_snippet_scene_3d
create_scenerview_renderer: create a SceneView OpenGL renderer to draw 3D points, lines, and meshes with configurable camera views
render_obb_wireframe_lines: render oriented bounding box wireframe lines with optional coordinate system axes using render_obbs_line
render_camera_frustum: render a camera frustum at a given rig pose with configurable scale and color using render_frustum
